name: PDF viewer
description: Shows a PDF inside the form (a contract, a quote, a policy) from an Attachments field or an upload: page by page, with zoom, rotation and the page text for screen readers.

props.name: allow_upload
props.label: Allow uploading a PDF
props.description: Shows a Choose a PDF button; the uploaded PDF becomes this field's value and is shown instead of the mapped document.

context.name: document
context.label: Document
context.description: An Attachments field of the form: the first PDF in it is shown.

output.description: The PDF as an uploaded file (a list of one)

accessibility.keyboard: Tab to the toolbar buttons (previous / next page, zoom out / in, fit to width, rotate) and to the page. On the page: Page Down / Page Up turn pages (after scrolling to the end of a zoomed page), Home / End go to the first / last page, + / - zoom, 0 fits the width. Each page is an image named "Page 2 of 7, file name", followed by the page's text for screen readers.

author: UserTasks
